messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"TADAM","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"TADAM","units":[{"chapter":47,"source_ref":"47:1","text":"'Blessed art thou, O Lord, for thou hast had pity on Thy creature.'"},{"chapter":48,"source_ref":"48:1","text":"Then Seth saw the hand of God stretched out holding Adam and he handed him over to"},{"chapter":48,"source_ref":"48:2","text":"Michael, saying: 'Let him be in thy charge till the day of Judgement in punishment, till the last years when I will convert his sorrow into joy."},{"chapter":48,"source_ref":"48:3","text":"Then shall he sit on the throne of him who hath been his supplanter.'"},{"chapter":48,"source_ref":"48:4","text":"And the Lord said again to the angels Michael and Uriel: 'Bring me three linen clothes of byssus and spread them out over Adam and other linen clothes over Abel his son and bury Adam and Abel his son.'"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 47:1, 48:1, 48:2, 48:3, 48:4.
